text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the academy. ...I had hit a complete 
and utter wall with my work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having no choice but to take a break, I 
happened to switch on the TV, and...

text_block_list.name: Playful Sound
text_block_list.text:
(――Tsukuten tsukuten, tsukuten ten♪ 
――Tsukuten tsukuten, tsukuten ten♪)

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
――Yu~~~koma is such a lovely place...♪ 
――With such wonderful ho~t spring 
water...♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Aah, that was so yummy!

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
For our guests' ultimate hot spring 
retreat. A healing time to soothe mind and 
body—

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
For hot spring recuperation, please do 
visit "Yukoma Ryokan."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...What is this? A very familiar face is 
showing up on the TV!
choice_data_list: Wh-What in the world is this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was standing there bewildered, 
the ringtone suddenly went off.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, is that you? How've things been 
lately? Feeling good?"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you saw it? Well, that makes this 
easy."

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since that commercial aired, 
inquiries have skyrocketed. We've been run 
ragged here."

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"For old times' sake, won't you come lend 
me a hand?"

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
That's right~. Inquiries have been pouring 
in non-stop since this morning. There are 
even short clip reels trending on social 
media...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ring ring, ring ring ring)

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, another call. At this rate, I may 
as well carry the phone on my back.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Yes~, an extended stay, is it? I'd 
be happy to take your reservation♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yunohana... is on the phone. Then that 
leaves you!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
A party of guests arriving by car from out 
of town seems to have gotten lost on the 
way here. Go go meet them, will ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ring――)

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Yukoma Inn. Landlady Hoshina 
speaking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Back-to-back phone calls, plus endless 
customer requests. It is, indeed, utter 
chaos.
choice_data_list:
(I might completely collapse just from 
today...!)

(I might completely collapse just from 
today...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Break time arrived. I had been moving 
almost purely on reflex, so I couldn't 
remember a thing that happened.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Ah, good work out there.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
How's it going? Getting back into hot 
spring duties after so long?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...Looking at your face, are you totally 
burnt out?
choice_data_list: Still, it's a nice change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every once in a while, focusing intensely 
on something completely different clears 
my head.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I do that, it feels like all the 
jammed gears in my head suddenly start 
flowing smoothly—

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong?
choice_data_list:
It looks like the issue I was stuck on at 
work is about to be solved.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? Well, that's what matters 
most.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Trainers are a troublesome bunch. They 
focus so hard on their trainees that they 
develop tunnel vision.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
It's easy to get overwhelmed. ...Though 
I'm acting all high and mighty, I was the 
same way once.
choice_data_list:
...Don't tell me the reason you called me 
here isââ

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Well, looks like we can handle things on 
our end this afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Once you've had a short break, feel free 
to head back to the academy.
choice_data_list: Um, Proprietress! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Don't thank them after they worked 
you to the bone!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...Go out and run your heart out today 
too, Trainer!
